text:
Emily: Heads up — my PR #842 for SDK snippets is failing docs CI: Vale + markdown-lint + spellcheck. Docs preview didn't come up. Anyone free to eyeball? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview failed for commit 3af2b8 — errors: PRR001 (Vale), MD013 (line length), 3 spelling suggestions. See CI logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/842/logs

Sahil: can you paste the Vale output here?

Emily: sure, pasted below:
```
docs/snippets/sdk/getting-started.md:42: ERROR PRR001 Consider avoiding passive voice in this sentence.
docs/snippets/sdk/getting-started.md:55: WARNING PRR001 'is recommended' -> prefer active phrasing.
docs/snippets/sdk/getting-started.md:78: MD013 Line length: 145/80.
Spellcheck: behaviours -> behaviour (suggestions: behavior)
```

Jordan: PRR001 is the new 'avoid_deemphasis' rule we turned on last week. For code/example blocks you can add an HTML comment to skip Vale for that region: `<!--vale: disable PRR001-->` before the block and `<!--vale: enable PRR001-->` after.

Marta: also MD013 is complaining about the long example line — easiest fix is to break the long literal across lines or wrap it in a multi-line code block.

Emily: thanks. I'll push a tiny fix. quick question: will fixes trigger the docs-preview? last time the preview skipped for a force-push from a fork.

docs-ci-bot: Preview trigger rules: previews run for commits pushed to the main repo or if the PR has the `ci/preview` label. You can reproduce locally with `./scripts/ci docs-preview` which runs Vale/markdown-lint/spellcheck the same way.

Kevin: :thumbsup: If you need fast approval once green, tag me as reviewer. note we have a small merge freeze window from 18:00-20:00 UTC today — try to merge outside that.

Emily: pushed fix: wrapped long lines and added `<!--vale: disable PRR001-->` around the snippet. PTAL @Kevin @Jordan

Jordan: LGTM, one tiny nit — spellcheck flagged 'behaviour' in the example. We standardize on US spelling 'behavior' across docs.

Emily: fixed that too, force-pushed. CI running again.

docs-ci-bot: Docs Preview: success! Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.internal/ — Vale warnings cleared, MD013 cleared, spellcheck: 0 matches.

Kevin: Reviewed and approved. @Emily you can merge once the preview link is stable (give it ~2 minutes to warm up).

Emily: merging now. Thanks everyone :tada:

Marta: nice — can we add a short line to CONTRIBUTING.md reminding folks to run `./scripts/ci docs-preview` locally before opening PRs? would save back-and-forth.

Sahil: good call — I just added it in a follow-up PR (docs: add local preview step to contributing).
